evals.prompt: Generate a commit message for my staged changes
evals.expected_output: A conventional commit message saved to .scratch/COMMIT.md
assertions: output follows conventional commit format: type(scope): description
type is one of: feat, fix, chore, refactor, docs, test, style, perf, ci, build
description is imperative mood and under 72 characters

evals.prompt: I just finished fixing a bug, help me write a good commit
evals.expected_output: Generates a fix-type conventional commit message
assertions: scope reflects the area of the bugfix

evals.prompt: Write a PR description for my branch
evals.expected_output: Skill should NOT activate (this is PR description, not commit message)
